artifact.title: Hiring trends in India

aaac9b77-a30f-5bb2-87b9-9450fdc44136.content_text: Hiring trends in India, 2026 edition. The survey covered 4,200 employers across 12 sectors. Median time to hire fell to 31 days, down from 38 days a year earlier. 27% of employers said they now use structured interviews for every role. Remote roles made up 18% of postings. Employers reported 2.3 million open roles nationally.
